name: Couch Stretch
instructions: Kneel facing away from a couch or bench and place the top of one foot against it behind you.
Step your other foot forward into a lunge position.
Raise your torso upright and tuck your pelvis by squeezing your back glute.
Hold the stretch for 20 to 30 seconds.
longevityNotes: Mobility is use-it-or-lose-it. Ten minutes of daily joint work preserves the ranges that keep you independent — reaching, bending, and getting up from the floor.
overview: A deep stretch for the hip flexors and quadriceps using a couch or bench to hold the back foot.

safetyNotes: Pad the knee; back off if you feel sharp knee or hip pain.
